name: Inventory Valuation Detail
description: Provides a reference on how to access the Inventory Valuation Detail report from the QuickBooks Online Report Service.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The end date of the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_date must be less than end_date. Use if you want the report to cover an explicit date range; otherwise, use date_macro to cover a standard report date range. If not specified value of date_macro is used.

parameters.name: end_svcdate
parameters.description: The end date of the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_date must be less than end_date. Use if you want the report to cover an explicit date range; otherwise, use date_macro to cover a standard report date range. If not specified value of date_macro is used.

parameters.name: date_macro
parameters.description: Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use the start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range.

parameters.name: svcdate_macro
parameters.description: Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use the start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range.

parameters.name: start_svcdate
parameters.description: The start date of the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_date must be less than end_date. Use if you want the report to cover an explicit date range; otherwise, use date_macro to cover a standard report date range. If not specified value of date_macro is used.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: The field in the transaction by which to group results.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: The start date of the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_date must be less than end_date. Use if you want the report to cover an explicit date range; otherwise, use date_macro to cover a standard report date range. If not specified value of date_macro is used.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Column types to show in the report.
